## Multivariate Outlier Removal

```{r}

# Select numeric channels
logdf_H <- logdf %>%
  dplyr::select(FSC_H:APC_H)

# Compute robust covariance estimate
output75_test <- cov.mcd(
  logdf_H,
  quantile.used = nrow(logdf_H) * 0.75
)

saveRDS(output75_test, "output75_test.rds")

# Compute Mahalanobis distances
mhmcd75_test <- mahalanobis(
  logdf_H,
  output75_test$center,
  output75_test$cov
)

saveRDS(mhmcd75_test, "mhmcd75_test.rds")



# Identify outliers
alpha <- 0.05

cutoff <- qchisq(
  p = 1 - alpha,
  df = ncol(logdf_H)
)

names_outlier_MCD75_test <- which(mhmcd75_test > cutoff)
excluded_md75_test <- names_outlier_MCD75_test

# Remove outliers
data_clean_mcd_test <- logdf[-excluded_md75_test, ]
```

## PCA

```{r}
clean_log <- data_clean_mcd_test  %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("log_"))

# Perform PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(clean_log, scale. = TRUE)

# Get summary of PCA
summary(pca_result)

# to find out loadings

pca_results_indepth <- get_pca_var(pca_result)
pca_results_indepth$contrib


head(pca_result)
head(pca_result$x)
dim(pca_result$x)

# Extract PCA scores (coordinates of the points)
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)

dim(pca_scores)
# Extract PCA loadings (directions of the vectors)
pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation)

# Plot PCA
ggplot(data = as.data.frame(pca_result$x), aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("Principal Component 1") +
  ylab("Principal Component 2") +
  ggtitle("PCA Plot") +
  geom_segment(data = pca_loadings, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * 5, yend = PC2 * 5), 
   arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")), color = "blue") +  
  geom_text(data = pca_loadings, aes(x = PC1 * 5, y = PC2 * 5, label = rownames(pca_loadings)),
   color = "red", vjust = 1) +  # Add labels to the vectors
  labs(title = "PCA Biplot", x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_classic()



```


## Initial Clustering

Mclust evaluates Gaussian mixture models across the specified covariance models `modelNames` and numbers of clusters G. The model with the highest BIC is slected automatically; increase or restrict G and/or modelNames as needed for your dataset. Check the BIC plot if you wish to assess or constrain the automatically selected model.

```{r}

#Select out only PC1 and PC2 to reduce dimensionality.

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)

# Select PC1 and PC2
pc1_pc2 <- pca_scores[, c("PC1", "PC2")]

# Run mclust

mod50_full <- Mclust(
  pc1_pc2,
  G = 1:30,
  modelNames = "VVV"
)

saveRDS(mod50_full, "mclust_mcd_noalgae_Test_pipeline.rds")

summary(mod50_full, parameters = TRUE)


# Add cluster classification from Mclust to PCA scores
pc1_pc2$class <- as.factor(mod50_full$classification)




```

```{r}
# ---- Prepare data for plotting ----
# pca_result: result of prcomp(clean_log, scale. = TRUE)
# mod50_full: result of Mclust(pc1_pc2, G = 1:50, ...)

# 1) PCA scores (ensure PC1 & PC2 exist)
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)   # PC1, PC2, ...
if (!all(c("PC1", "PC2") %in% colnames(pca_scores))) {
  stop("PC1 and PC2 not found in pca_result$x")
}

# 2) Create a plotting data.frame that includes the Mclust class
plot_df <- data.frame(PC1 = pca_scores$PC1,
                      PC2 = pca_scores$PC2,
                      class = as.factor(mod50_full$classification))  # convert to factor

# 3) PCA loadings for PC1 and PC2
pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation[, c("PC1", "PC2")])
pca_loadings$feature <- rownames(pca_loadings)

# 4) Scale loadings so arrows appear nicely on the PC scatter
#    This chooses a scale factor based on the data spread (tweak multiplier if arrows too long/short)
scale_factor <- 0.7 * max(c(abs(range(plot_df$PC1)), abs(range(plot_df$PC2))))
pca_loadings$PC1s <- pca_loadings$PC1 * scale_factor
pca_loadings$PC2s <- pca_loadings$PC2 * scale_factor

# ---- Plot with ggplot2 ----
library(ggplot2)
   # for unit()

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  # arrows from origin to scaled loading coordinates
  geom_segment(data = pca_loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1s, yend = PC2s),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # labels at arrow tips
  geom_text(data = pca_loadings,
            aes(x = PC1s, y = PC2s, label = feature),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "PCA with Mclust classification",
       x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "Cluster") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```

## Remove Machine Noise and Recluster (if needed)

```{r}

## Optional: Remove a Noise Cluster and Recluster
#
# If one cluster appears to represent machine noise or debris after visual
# inspection of the PCA plot, remove that cluster and rerun Mclust on the
# remaining observations. For this dataset, the noise cluster was Cluster 32.

# Specify the cluster to remove
noise_cluster <- 32

# Remove the noise cluster from the PCA scores
keep_idx <- mod50_full$classification != noise_cluster

pc_for_clust <- pca_scores[, c("PC1", "PC2")]
pc_for_clust_no32 <- pc_for_clust[keep_idx, ]

# Rerun Mclust
mod_recluster_test <- Mclust(
  pc_for_clust_no32,
  G = 1:30,
  modelNames = "VVV"
)

saveRDS(mod_recluster_test, "mclust_recluster_test.rds")

# Visualize the reclustered PCA scores
df_reclust <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pc_for_clust_no32$PC1,
  PC2 = pc_for_clust_no32$PC2,
  class = factor(mod_recluster_test$classification)
)

ggplot(df_reclust, aes(PC1, PC2, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_classic()

# Expand the new cluster assignments back to the full dataset
new_full_class_test <- rep(NA, nrow(pc_for_clust))
new_full_class_test[keep_idx] <- mod_recluster_test$classification

# Attach new cluster assignments
pca_plot_df_test <- data.frame(
  pc_for_clust,
  class_old = factor(mod50_full$classification),
  class_new = factor(new_full_class_test)
)


data_clean_mcd_test$new_mclust_class <- factor(new_full_class_test)

write.csv(
  pca_plot_df_test,
  "pca_scores_with_new_class_test.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)



```

```{r}
## Assess clustering uncertainty
#
# Mclust assigns each observation to the cluster with the highest posterior probability. The uncertainty value (0–1) reflects confidence in that assignment, with values near 0 indicating high confidence and larger values indicating more ambiguous classifications.

# Add Mclust outputs to the reclustered PCA dataframe
df_reclust$uncertainty <- mod_recluster_test$uncertainty
df_reclust$post_max <- apply(mod_recluster_test$z, 1, max)
df_reclust$class <- factor(mod_recluster_test$classification)

# Summarize uncertainty
summary(df_reclust$uncertainty)
summary(df_reclust$post_max)

# View the 10 most confidently classified observations
df_reclust %>%
  arrange(uncertainty) %>%
  head(10)

# View the 10 least confidently classified observations
df_reclust %>%
  arrange(desc(uncertainty)) %>%
  head(10)
```

## Remove Outliers of each cluster

Calculate the centroid of each Mclust group and remove observations in the upper 2.5% of Euclidean distance from their assigned centroid. This helps remove peripheral observations while preserving the overall cluster structure.

```{r}
# Calculate cluster centroids
centroids <- df_reclust %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(
    cx = mean(PC1),
    cy = mean(PC2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate distance from each observation to its cluster centroid
df_reclust2 <- df_reclust %>%
  left_join(centroids, by = "class") %>%
  mutate(
    dist_to_centroid = sqrt((PC1 - cx)^2 + (PC2 - cy)^2)
  )

# Identify the most distant 2.5% of observations within each cluster
df_reclust2 <- df_reclust2 %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  mutate(
    outside_97.5 = dist_to_centroid >
      quantile(dist_to_centroid, 0.975)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Remove cluster outliers
df_reclust_final <- df_reclust2 %>%
  filter(!outside_97.5)

## Visualize Cluster Outlier Removal

# Plot before removing cluster outliers
p_before <- ggplot(df_reclust2, aes(PC1, PC2, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.9, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(df_reclust2, outside_97.5),
    aes(PC1, PC2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    fill = "yellow",
    shape = 21,
    size = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Before 97.5% Distance Removal",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Plot after removing cluster outliers
p_after <- ggplot(df_reclust_final, aes(PC1, PC2, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.9, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "After 97.5% Distance Removal",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Display plots side-by-side with a shared legend
p_before + p_after 
```

## Create Final Dataset

```{r}
## Create Final Dataset
# export_df contains:
# - PCA coordinates
# - Final Mclust cluster assignments
# - Original flow cytometry measurements and metadata
# after removal of machine noise and cluster-specific outliers.


# Retain metadata for observations remaining after cluster outlier removal
meta_final_test <- df_clean_no_noise %>%
  slice(which(!df_reclust2$outside_97.5))

# Combine metadata with PCA coordinates and final cluster assignments
export_df_test <- bind_cols(
  df_reclust_final,
  meta_final_test
)

# Check dimensions
table(df_reclust2$outside_97.5)
nrow(export_df_test)

write.csv(
  export_df_test,
  "full_recluster_97p5_filtered_test.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
